title: Cloudflare Status - Cloudflare Fedramp Dashboard and Access
text:

Status: resolved

- 2026-10-16T18:15:23.745Z: investigating - Cloudflare is investigating issues with accessing the Cloudflare Fedramp Dashboard and related Cloudflare Access services. Logging into dashboards and applications protected by Fedramp Access is impacted. These issues do not affect the serving of cached files via the Cloudflare CDN or other security features at the Edge. Cloudflare is investigating issues with accessing the Cloudflare Fedramp Dashboard and related Cloudflare Access services. Logging into dashboards and applications protected by Fedramp Access is impacted. These issues do not affect the serving of cached files via the Cloudflare CDN or other security features at the Edge. Cloudflare has identified the issue and is working on a fix.
